title: The report shows one row for each technician who clocked time in the range at the selected locations
custom_preconds:
1. Technician A clocked time (work-order and/or internal) in the selected date range at the selected location.
2. Technician B clocked NO time in that range.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Technician Utilization report for that range and location.
2. Look for rows for technicians A and B.
custom_expected:
1. Technician A has exactly ONE row.
2. Technician B has NO row - only technicians with clocked time in the selected range at the selected location(s) appear.
